slides.label: 7 MOVES. EVERY SOURCE CHECKED.
slides.sub: Most take under 10 minutes. All free. Swipe.

slides.label: FILES YOU NEVER FROZE
claims: Credit files most people never freeze.
Not Equifax. Not Experian. Not TransUnion.
slides.body: ChexSystems. NCTUE. Innovis. LexisNexis. One of them tracks every checking account you open.

title: FREEZE THE
OTHER FOUR
slides.action: Start with one tonight. Save the PIN they give you. Lift it before you open a new bank or phone account.

quotes.text: ChexSystems **does not charge a fee** for placing or lifting a security freeze
**A free security freeze** can prevent access to your NCTUE credit report
**There is no charge** for the addition, temporary lift, or removal of a Security Freeze.
LexisNexis Risk Solutions **does not charge a fee** to apply, lift or remove a security freeze

title: LOCK YOUR TAXES
WITH A 6-DIGIT PIN
slides.action: IRS.gov/IPPIN. Anyone with an SSN can get one. The online tool closes *mid-November*.

quotes.text: a six-digit number that **prevents someone else from filing a tax return** using your Social Security number
Get my IP PIN, which is available from **mid-January through mid-November**.

title: LOCK YOUR
PHONE NUMBER
slides.action: A SIM swap sends your bank texts to a scammer. All 3 big carriers have a *free* lock in the app.

quotes.text: You can set up Number Lock **for free** to protect your mobile number from an unauthorized move.
SIM Protection is **a free feature** offered to all T-Mobile Postpaid customers.
AT&T has introduced **a free feature** for extra protection from unauthorized changes to your AT&T wireless account.

proof.foot: Turn the lock off before you upgrade or switch carriers.

title: MD BANNED MEDICAL
DEBT FROM YOUR
CREDIT REPORT
slides.action: Since Oct 1, 2025. Pull your free weekly report at AnnualCreditReport.com. See a medical collection? *Dispute it.*

quotes.text: Neither a debt collector, nor anyone who provides medical services, **may report medical debt** to a consumer reporting agency.

title: MAKE AI AUDIT
YOUR HOSPITAL BILL
slides.action: Ask for the *itemized* bill. Black out your name and account number. Paste it in.
slides.sourceLine: REAL RUN ON A SAMPLE BILL. 07 OCT 2026

proof.prompt: Table every line. Flag repeats with the same date and code. Check the total. Write questions for billing.
output: !The total does not match. The bill's total is $100.00 more than the lines add up to.
proof.foot: Sample bill made for this test. Output trimmed, not edited.

title: MAKE AI FIND EVERY
SUBSCRIPTION
slides.action: Download 90 days of transactions as a CSV. Delete the account numbers. Ask for the yearly cost.
slides.sourceLine: REAL RUN ON A SAMPLE CSV. 07 OCT 2026

proof.prompt: Find every charge that repeats. Estimate the yearly cost. Sort highest first.
output: PHOTOEDIT PRO appears only twice (no July 18 charge).
proof.foot: Sample file made for this test. Output trimmed, not edited.

title: MAKE AI READ
YOUR LEASE

proof.prompt: List every fee and deadline. Quote the exact lease sentence and section for each.
